name: Two-gap recovery with modest holds
description: Start 12 stops and four evenly spaced buses with fixed passenger arrivals. Hold Bus 1 for 60 seconds at minute 20. From minute 25 through minute 60, check every 15 seconds. At a service stop, hold an eligible bus for 30 seconds only when its gap ahead is below 90% of ideal and its gap behind exceeds 110% of ideal. Compare passenger time and queues with the identical delay and no policy.
